# Retrospective graduations reader: discussion-marker detection joins the coverage label

## Context

The last fact class of the retrospective enrichment family (split from #14721 at PR time — the other five classes are live). Graduations are recorded as Discussion closures carrying the graduation-marker comment vocabulary; `gh search` does not cover Discussions, so this reader needs a bounded discussions GraphQL query (recently-closed discussions, marker detection in the closing comments).

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] A bounded reader returning `{ref, headline, at}` facts for graduations within the window.
- [ ] Slots into the compositional coverage label with ONE array entry (the call-site's `coveredClasses` design — a failing reader drops exactly its class).
- [ ] Integration test extension: graduation facts counted + rendered from the written handoff; firewall re-asserted.

## Related

#14721 (the enrichment family — five classes live at its close) · #14603/#14706 (render + assembler contracts, merged).

Claimable — bounded single-reader; the compositional label makes it a one-array-entry slot-in.

* feat(graph): retrospective graduations reader completes the enrichment coverage (#14738)

The last fact class of the handoff-retrospective enrichment family. fetchRecentGraduations reads recently-closed Discussions via a bounded GraphQL query (gh search has no Discussion coverage) and detects the graduation-marker vocabulary, returning {ref, headline, at} facts. Slots into the compositional coverage label as one array entry (per-class best-effort: a failing reader drops exactly its class). The assembler + render already declared the graduations class; this wires the missing reader. Integration coverage extended: graduation facts counted + rendered from the written handoff, out-of-window folded out.

* fix(graph): widen fetchRecentGraduations window to 50, matching sibling readers (#14738)

The retrospective graduations reader fetched discussions(first:30) while every
sibling window-fact reader (merged PRs, closed issues, opened issues) uses
--limit 50. Under a busy window (>30 recently-updated closed discussions),
graduations past the 30th-most-recent could fall outside the fetch before the
since-window filter runs. Aligns to 50 so the method matches its own JSDoc
('like every sibling reader'). Folds in Grace's non-blocking second-read nit
(surfaced on the #14893 review) pre-review.

* test(graph): stub fetchRecentGraduations in the session-failure test — hermetic (#14738)

Euclid's review caught a real hermeticity leak: the 'session reader failure
drops ONLY the session class' test stubbed every sibling reader EXCEPT the new
fetchRecentGraduations, so in an authenticated environment the reader hit live
GitHub Discussions and the coverage label gained a graduations class — making
the unit environment-dependent (green only where gh has no Discussions access).

Stub fetchRecentGraduations to a successful empty read so it stays a SURVIVING
class (present in the coverage label + honest 0 count), preserving the test's
'ONLY session drops' intent; update the expected label + add a Graduations:0
assertion. The reader is now never called against live state.
